subject: Literature
title: The Romantic Revolution
description: A fast breakdown of The Romantic Revolution for builders.

hook.text: By the late 1700s, writers were tired of cold reason and logic. They wanted emotion, nature, and wonder.

buildup.text: Romantic poets like Wordsworth and Coleridge argued that feelings and imagination mattered more than facts.

discovery.text: Their 1798 collection Lyrical Ballads is considered the opening shot of the Romantic movement in English.

twist.text: Romanticism celebrated individual genius, yet many of its greatest poets died tragically young.

climax.text: The movement transformed literature by placing subjective experience at the center of artistic creation.

punchline.text: Feeling replaced thinking as literature's engine.

quiz.question: What did the Romantic movement prioritize over Enlightenment rationality?
